acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p stoa-transit -- dns_auth_cache; all tests pass
description:
Implement functions that extract DNS lookup keys from raw article bytes.

File: crates/transit/src/dns_auth_cache.rs

```rust
/// Extract all (selector, domain) pairs from DKIM-Signature headers.
/// Also handles ARC-Message-Signature headers (same tag-value format).
pub fn extract_dkim_selectors(article_bytes: &[u8]) -> Vec<(String, String)>

/// Extract the RFC 5321 From domain for SPF lookup.
/// Uses the envelope sender domain if available; falls back to From: header domain.
/// Returns None if no usable domain can be extracted.
pub fn extract_spf_domain(article_bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<String>

/// Extract the RFC 5322 From: header domain for DMARC lookup.
/// DMARC alignment is based on the From: header domain, not the envelope.
/// Returns None if From: is absent or unparseable.
pub fn extract_dmarc_domain(article_bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<String>
```

Algorithm for extract_dkim_selectors: same as before, but also
scan ARC-Message-Signature headers (same tag-value format as DKIM-Signature).

Algorithm for extract_spf_domain / extract_dmarc_domain:
- Scan headers until blank line
- For From:, extract the domain part of the first addr-spec
  (right of '@', strip trailing '>' if angle-bracketed)
- Use from_utf8_lossy; return None on any ambiguity rather than guessing

Defensive rules: return None/empty rather than panic on malformed headers.

Tests:
- All original DKIM tests (extract_single_signature, folded, multiple, stops_at_body)
- extract_arc_selectors: ARC-Message-Signature header → (selector, domain) pair
- extract_spf_domain_from_from_header: From: alice@example.com → Some("example.com")
- extract_spf_domain_angle_bracketed: From: Alice <alice@example.com> → Some("example.com")
- extract_dmarc_domain_matches_from: same as spf for DMARC
- extract_domain_missing_from_header: no From: → None
title: Extract DNS lookup keys from article headers (DKIM selectors, From domain)
